user.title: Connect to eBichelchen
user.description: Use a student or parent IAM account. eduKey, LuxTrust and eID are not supported. Credentials are stored in your local Home Assistant configuration.

students.title: Choose calendars
students.description: Create a separate eBichelchen calendar for each selected student. Display these together with your existing calendars in a Calendar card. Session renewal happens automatically, independently of this refresh interval.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect eBichelchen
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the current password for the same IAM account.

error.invalid_auth: IAM rejected the login. Check your credentials.
error.unsupported_auth: This login requires MFA, LuxTrust, eID, or an unsupported authentication step.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach Education.lu. Try again later.
error.unsupported_role: Use a student or parent account. Teacher and supervisor accounts are not supported.
error.access_denied: This account cannot access the selected student. Check access in eBichelchen.
error.invalid_response: Education.lu returned an unexpected response. The integration may need updating. {error_detail}

abort.no_students: No accessible students were returned for this account.
abort.wrong_account: Use the same IAM account as the original setup.

init.title: Calendar refresh
init.description: Default: every 30 minutes. Sessions are reused and renewed when needed. Changes reload the integration.
